title: Steam next fest results
author: netplay-ent
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/1hpli1j12wxh1.png

The results for my upcoming medieval RPG / Sim - Total of 3050 wishlists due to next fest.  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4860010/Medieval\_Ascendant/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4860010/Medieval_Ascendant/)

18 reviews on the demo page - most of them positive and one guy just stating "ai slop".   
Best performing was china, guess they don't care too much about ai usage as the western neo-amish.

comments.author: ongix
comments.body:
GJ and your game looks great

Hopefully by the time I'm ready for marketing my game the western audience will stop hating on AI assisted game dev for no reason it's getting tiresome

replies.body: To be honest, i think you won't notice any difference in the upcoming games. I started with the game in march, over the period of time the llms got so much better. The prototype for my next game just looks like any other game, can't tell any difference.
